fr.root.designSystem.title: The shared visual foundation for the website and client portal.
fr.root.designSystem.intro: This page renders every token, primitive and state defined in docs/design/design-system.md and docs/design/patterns.md. It is the reference during development. It is intentionally not linked from production navigation.
fr.root.designSystem.colors.title: A small palette, used with intent.
fr.root.designSystem.colors.intro: Brand green is for actions and meaningful highlights only — never decoration. Green backgrounds always carry dark text; green text only appears on dark surfaces.
fr.root.designSystem.type.title: JetBrains Mono, tuned like an editorial type system.
fr.root.designSystem.type.intro: Headlines set tight and large; labels set small, uppercase and tracked. Body copy never goes below 14px.
fr.root.designSystem.components.title: Restrained primitives, aligned to the reference.
fr.root.designSystem.components.intro: Buttons, badges, cards and links. One radius family, 1px borders, and no decoration beyond what the approved designs use.
fr.root.designSystem.states.title: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
fr.root.designSystem.states.intro: No color inventions. Skeleton uses the line tone, empty states a dashed border, errors stay on the paper surface with strong dark emphasis.
fr.root.designSystem.states.loading: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
fr.root.designSystem.states.whenProjectExis: When a project or request exists, it will appear here.
fr.root.designSystem.states.tryAgain: Try again, or contact support if the problem persists.
fr.root.designSystem.darkSurface.title: Dark sections carry the same system.
fr.root.designSystem.darkSurface.intro: Primary text turns light, secondary turns fog, and green is used for highlights. Border line darkens to keep the composition quiet.
fr.root.designSystem.brandSurface.title: One brand section per page, at most.
fr.root.designSystem.brandSurface.intro: Green backgrounds carry dark text. Use this sparingly — it is the loudest surface in the system.

nl.root.designSystem.title: The shared visual foundation for the website and client portal.
nl.root.designSystem.intro: This page renders every token, primitive and state defined in docs/design/design-system.md and docs/design/patterns.md. It is the reference during development. It is intentionally not linked from production navigation.
nl.root.designSystem.colors.title: A small palette, used with intent.
nl.root.designSystem.colors.intro: Brand green is for actions and meaningful highlights only — never decoration. Green backgrounds always carry dark text; green text only appears on dark surfaces.
nl.root.designSystem.type.title: JetBrains Mono, tuned like an editorial type system.
nl.root.designSystem.type.intro: Headlines set tight and large; labels set small, uppercase and tracked. Body copy never goes below 14px.
nl.root.designSystem.components.title: Restrained primitives, aligned to the reference.
nl.root.designSystem.components.intro: Buttons, badges, cards and links. One radius family, 1px borders, and no decoration beyond what the approved designs use.
nl.root.designSystem.states.title: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
nl.root.designSystem.states.intro: No color inventions. Skeleton uses the line tone, empty states a dashed border, errors stay on the paper surface with strong dark emphasis.
nl.root.designSystem.states.loading: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
nl.root.designSystem.states.whenProjectExis: When a project or request exists, it will appear here.
nl.root.designSystem.states.tryAgain: Try again, or contact support if the problem persists.
nl.root.designSystem.darkSurface.title: Dark sections carry the same system.
nl.root.designSystem.darkSurface.intro: Primary text turns light, secondary turns fog, and green is used for highlights. Border line darkens to keep the composition quiet.
nl.root.designSystem.brandSurface.title: One brand section per page, at most.
nl.root.designSystem.brandSurface.intro: Green backgrounds carry dark text. Use this sparingly — it is the loudest surface in the system.

pl.root.designSystem.title: The shared visual foundation for the website and client portal.
pl.root.designSystem.intro: This page renders every token, primitive and state defined in docs/design/design-system.md and docs/design/patterns.md. It is the reference during development. It is intentionally not linked from production navigation.
pl.root.designSystem.colors.title: A small palette, used with intent.
pl.root.designSystem.colors.intro: Brand green is for actions and meaningful highlights only — never decoration. Green backgrounds always carry dark text; green text only appears on dark surfaces.
pl.root.designSystem.type.title: JetBrains Mono, tuned like an editorial type system.
pl.root.designSystem.type.intro: Headlines set tight and large; labels set small, uppercase and tracked. Body copy never goes below 14px.
pl.root.designSystem.components.title: Restrained primitives, aligned to the reference.
pl.root.designSystem.components.intro: Buttons, badges, cards and links. One radius family, 1px borders, and no decoration beyond what the approved designs use.
pl.root.designSystem.states.title: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
pl.root.designSystem.states.intro: No color inventions. Skeleton uses the line tone, empty states a dashed border, errors stay on the paper surface with strong dark emphasis.
pl.root.designSystem.states.loading: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
pl.root.designSystem.states.whenProjectExis: When a project or request exists, it will appear here.
pl.root.designSystem.states.tryAgain: Try again, or contact support if the problem persists.
pl.root.designSystem.darkSurface.title: Dark sections carry the same system.
pl.root.designSystem.darkSurface.intro: Primary text turns light, secondary turns fog, and green is used for highlights. Border line darkens to keep the composition quiet.
pl.root.designSystem.brandSurface.title: One brand section per page, at most.
pl.root.designSystem.brandSurface.intro: Green backgrounds carry dark text. Use this sparingly — it is the loudest surface in the system.

el.root.designSystem.title: The shared visual foundation for the website and client portal.
el.root.designSystem.intro: This page renders every token, primitive and state defined in docs/design/design-system.md and docs/design/patterns.md. It is the reference during development. It is intentionally not linked from production navigation.
el.root.designSystem.colors.title: A small palette, used with intent.
el.root.designSystem.colors.intro: Brand green is for actions and meaningful highlights only — never decoration. Green backgrounds always carry dark text; green text only appears on dark surfaces.
el.root.designSystem.type.title: JetBrains Mono, tuned like an editorial type system.
el.root.designSystem.type.intro: Headlines set tight and large; labels set small, uppercase and tracked. Body copy never goes below 14px.
el.root.designSystem.components.title: Restrained primitives, aligned to the reference.
el.root.designSystem.components.intro: Buttons, badges, cards and links. One radius family, 1px borders, and no decoration beyond what the approved designs use.
el.root.designSystem.states.title: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
el.root.designSystem.states.intro: No color inventions. Skeleton uses the line tone, empty states a dashed border, errors stay on the paper surface with strong dark emphasis.
el.root.designSystem.states.loading: Loading, empty and error — consistent surfaces.
el.root.designSystem.states.whenProjectExis: When a project or request exists, it will appear here.
el.root.designSystem.states.tryAgain: Try again, or contact support if the problem persists.
el.root.designSystem.darkSurface.title: Dark sections carry the same system.
el.root.designSystem.darkSurface.intro: Primary text turns light, secondary turns fog, and green is used for highlights. Border line darkens to keep the composition quiet.
el.root.designSystem.brandSurface.title: One brand section per page, at most.
el.root.designSystem.brandSurface.intro: Green backgrounds carry dark text. Use this sparingly — it is the loudest surface in the system.
